Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
reyda seddiki wrote:
> Leather Jacket txt says "if a minion successfuly equip w/ L J, untap it
> at end of turn."
>
> 1 - My vampire equips LJ via "Vast Wealth". She untaps, right ?

At the end of the turn, yeah.
Equipping via Vast Wealth is still equipping.

> 2 - My vampire equips LJ by taking various equipment from another minion
> i control. It seems like he succesfuly equipped. She untaps, right ?

Yes.

> (by the way, can i take equipment from one of my own vampire in torpor ?)

Yes.

> 3- I use Kostantin's ability, to steal someone else's Leather Jacket.
> the result of stealing is Kostantin is now equipped with a leather
> jacket. Does Kostantin untap at end of my turn ?

No. Stealing equipment is not the same as equipping. (for instance, no
cost is paid).

> 4- I block a bleeding minion with Lucian. I steal acting minion's
> Leather jacket as a strike. Does Lucian untap at end of acting minion's
> turn ?

No, stealing equipment is not the same as equipping.

> Can i burn the jacket just on the round of combat i stole it to prevent
> opponent's strike ? Does Lucian untap even if i do so ?

No. Stolen equipment cannot be used for the rest of the round.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The rulebook under "equip" identifies the exchange as an "equip" action,
and says that the acting minion "equips" with the exchanged card(s) - which
is sufficient to satisfy LJ's card text. [6.1.3]

Stealing equipment is not "equipping" - the effect is just that the
equipment card is moved. [6.4.5] So this doesn't satisfy LJ's card text
for untapping.

Sorry for muddying the issue by referring to the cost being paid.



Messages.Author: Gomi no Sensei
Messages.Body:
ra...@videotron.ca (Rafid Armani) wrote in
<39b69556....@news.videotron.ca>:



Different mechanisms are at work. In one case, the equipment is taken
by an equip action. In the other, the equipment is taken by a special
ability, which is its own action and not equipping (Konstantin's special
ability does not use the word 'equip').
